reason: RASET identifies safety-critical MoE experts by contrastive harmful/benign activation and fine-tunes selected expert parameters while freezing router and other weights. Five open-weight MoE models show safety bypass with preserved general utility; this is a red-team/safety finding, not an efficiency improvement.
title: RASET: Router-Agnostic Safety-Critical Expert Tuning Exposes Localized Safety Enforcement Failures in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
